usable_fraction.note: share of a Li-ion pack's rated energy used before the BMS cut-off; measure on the bench

converter_efficiency.note: buck converter efficiency at about 1-2 A; measure on the bench

mcu_power_w.note: ESP32-class microcontroller average with Wi-Fi idle; measure on the bench

chassis_mass_kg.note: printed chassis, board, fasteners, caster and wiring; weigh it

min_operating_voltage.note: 3S Li-ion at 3.3 V per cell, near the end of useful charge; the pack's BMS cuts off at 8 V. Measure the voltage under load at end of run.

motor_current_limit_a.note: Requirement for the board plan: the motor driver regulates each motor to 1.2 A. Without it two stalled motors (2 x 2.6 A) exceed the pack's 4 A.

step_height_mm.note: door threshold the robot must climb

drive_wheel_load_fraction.note: share of weight on the two drive wheels with a rear caster; measure on the bench with a scale under each wheel
